Energy Sustainability Research Laboratory
Members of The Ohio State University's Energy Sustainability Research Group work on solving important problems related to Energy Sustainability, where engineering, natural and physical science, economics, social organization, and policy intersect.
Many of the challenges associated with understanding and advancing energy sustainability do not lie in a particular academic discipline. We investigate important questions at the intersections of those traditional disciplines to glean insights that may not reveal themselves if the disciplines involved were viewed in isolation.
